intent: click the login button to sign in
explanation: Known fix from knowledge base (used 2 times before): Known fix from knowledge base (used 2 times before): The old CSS class selector '.login-submit-btn' does not match any element on the SauceDemo login page, causing a timeout. The login button is an input with type='submit' and value='Login', which has an implicit role of 'button' with accessible name 'Login'. Using getByRole is robust and aligned with user intent.
